general: Only when the source shows a white bean icon above the NORTHBEAN wordmark at top-left over a dark background, keep that stacked logo anchored about 5% from the left edge and 8% from the top at about 18% of canvas width; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a full-bleed dark wood background in #3a2416 and #111111, keep it full-bleed edge-to-edge with the photo/background as the flexible element absorbing any extra width or height; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows headline and price text on the left over the dark background, keep them left-aligned in a column about 37% of canvas width starting at the 5% left margin, in #ffffff; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows black product cans with white labels on the right, keep the product group on the right about 46% of canvas width and 71% of canvas height without enlarging the fixed text or logo elements to fill space; otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a single outlined CTA button below the price line, keep it left-aligned to the same left margin at about 19% of canvas width and 11% of canvas height with a white outline and transparent fill; otherwise keep the source structure.
Only when the source uses #111111, #3a2416, and #ffffff, keep text, logo, and CTA in #ffffff over the dark background and do not introduce other colours; otherwise keep the source structure.
never: Never add a bottom band, top band, side panel, tab, or frame that is not in the source.
Never add a second logo, badge, sticker, seal, or extra brand mark.
Never add additional CTA buttons, buttons, or promotional labels beyond the single outlined CTA shown in the source.
Never add a white panel or card behind the logo, headline, price line, or CTA.
Never add extra products, props, headlines, or text blocks that are not in the source.
text: English Latin script only, left-aligned to the same 5% left edge for logo, headline, price line, and CTA.
Headline is large bold white sans-serif over two lines, clearly larger than the price line below it.
Price line is regular white sans-serif at about 40% of headline size, placed below the headline.
Logo wordmark is uppercase bold white sans-serif below the bean icon.
CTA label is medium white sans-serif centered inside the outlined rectangle.
